title: Appointment of Deputies for Individuals No Longer Capable of Decisions
what_it_is: Appointment of Deputies for Individuals No Longer Capable of Decisions

sections.label: Mental Capacity Act deputyship panel
sections.summary: MSF will amend the Mental Capacity Act to allow professional donees and deputies, and a panel of 18 professionals can apply to be deputies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: The number is currently small, but it could increase.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: MSF will amend the Mental Capacity Act this year to allow professional donees and deputies to be appointed under such scenarios.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: For those who do not have anyone to apply for deputyship and are unable to afford private sector services, we have also established a panel of professionals, who could apply to the Court to be appointed as deputies for these individuals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: There are currently 18 public-spirited professionals from the financial, healthcare, legal and social work sectors on this panel.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: As each deputyship case involves multiple steps, the pilot is still on-going.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, the feedback that we have received has been positive about how the vulnerable individuals have benefited.

sections.label: Refining pilot work processes
sections.summary: Work processes are being refined based on pilot experiences and inputs from partners such as social workers to let more vulnerable individuals benefit.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: This is just one example of the many different things that can happen when we bring this on board.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: We are now refining the work processes based on our experiences with the pilot, as well as inputs from key partners, such as social workers, to allow more vulnerable individuals to benefit.
